environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. CORS is configured to allow all origins. The function relies solely on session cookies for authentication with no CSRF protection. Any website can craft a cross-origin POST request that will include the victim's session cookie, triggering state machine executions for sensitive account modifications.
